description: This Java class defines the data structure for minimum loan product related details in the Fineract project, including interest rates, grace periods, amortization, and repayment details.

classes.name: LoanProductRelatedDetailMinimumData
classes.description: Represents minimum related details for a loan product, including interest, grace periods, amortization, and repayment configurations.

methods.name: LoanProductRelatedDetailMinimumData
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields with provided parameters, applying default to null if zero for certain grace period fields.

methods.name: defaultToNullIfZero
methods.description: Utility method to convert zero Integer values to null.

methods.name: isAllowPartialPeriodInterestCalculation
methods.description: Returns whether partial period interest calculation is allowed.

methods.name: getCurrencyData
methods.description: Returns the currency data associated with the loan product.

methods.name: getGraceOnInterestCharged
methods.description: Returns the interest charging grace period.

methods.name: getGraceOnInterestPayment
methods.description: Returns the interest payment grace period.

methods.name: getGraceOnPrincipalPayment
methods.description: Returns the principal payment grace period.

methods.name: getRecurringMoratoriumOnPrincipalPeriods
methods.description: Returns the number of periods for recurring moratorium on principal.

methods.name: getNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the interest rate per period.

methods.name: getInterestPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the interest period frequency type.

methods.name: getAnnualNominalInterestRate
methods.description: Returns the annual nominal interest rate.

methods.name: getInterestMethod
methods.description: Returns the interest calculation method.

methods.name: getInterestCalculationPeriodMethod
methods.description: Returns the interest calculation period method.

methods.name: getRepayEvery
methods.description: Returns the repayment interval.

methods.name: getRepaymentPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the repayment period frequency type.

methods.name: getNumberOfRepayments
methods.description: Returns the total number of repayments.

methods.name: getAmortizationMethod
methods.description: Returns the amortization method.

methods.name: getGraceOnArrearsAgeing
methods.description: Returns the grace on arrears aging, fixed at 0.

methods.name: getDaysInMonthType
methods.description: Returns the days in month type value.

methods.name: getDaysInYearType
methods.description: Returns the days in year type value.

methods.name: isInterestRecognitionOnDisbursementDate
methods.description: Indicates if interest is recognized on disbursement date.

methods.name: getDaysInYearCustomStrategy
methods.description: Returns the custom strategy for days in year.
